description: Na₂HgS₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pbca space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six S atoms. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.89-3.25 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four S atoms. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.73-2.86 Å. Hg is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to two S atoms. Both Hg-S bond lengths are 2.34 Å. There are two inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Hg atom. In the second S site, S is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Hg atom.
